Status: SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED. This is a fresh private controller consumer, not a resume backup.
All actual admission, CPU fixtures, imports, execution, builds, lints, GPU/model work and Git/cleanup belong to Main.
No current worktree, prior package/report/registry, model/fixture or qualified direct_owner was edited.
The supplied qualification and health files are deliberately unresolved. They cannot authorize execution.

Closure and dependencies
Seven new controller Python files: policy/common/protocol/mapping/run_root/controller_cpu_fixtures/mock_model.
mapping.py is source-derived from the old qualified controller's bounded owned-PID self-map reader, extended
for actual math/thread/standard runtime libraries. It requires NEW CPU/review qualification; no old parser or
model qualification is reused as validity for a pristine binary. Exact qualified direct_owner.py v5 is the sole
external source dependency, SHAa29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f, checked
immediately before import. No model, runtime, helper or controller source was imported/executed here.
production-source-pins.json captures302 Xe and549 official source/config/dependency-metadata files by SHA.
This capture is not a build/backend qualification. Main must bind current actual inference ELF/recipe/source
receipts. Manifest and option-source-audit.json provide explicit source parser/env anchors; all fixed CLI option
names have exact parser branches. No glued --short-read65536/--spec8/--suffix-draft0 spellings.

Frozen campaigns
Only NEW B/latest-update-pristine-model-root-v4/{xe-startup,xe-model,official-startup,official-model}, fixed order.
Each engine first READY/QUIT only, fresh process. Its own GEN32K+16 follows only a sameboot successfully closed
startup and Main's new reviewed-startup hash. All earlier campaign roots must be passed/complete/inactive,
normal QUIT, exact immutable qualification and fresh kernel gate. An existing failed/incomplete root blocks
further runs: no retry, adoption, overwrite or namespace recycling. No output directory or owner import on
pending qualification/health. An actual valid admission then imports owner, takes the nonblocking exclusive
owned-v0141-measurement.lock, and creates the fresh root. Main must delegate without a conflicting outer flock.

Exact engines/providers
Xe: pristine da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7, build/free/strata,
SHA6e985615949171bc9938dd8a22c7fc405495481c05d7990496a14c2de48849b1, source LLVM7.1.1 install.
Official: pristine7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d, build/official-sycl-icpx/strata,
SHA49025c6cd2bd9bb09869f2a30e30b6c5618d3166bb8e8c751f0b9546b1f3340f, installed icpx2026.1 compiler/lib
and MKL2026.1/lib. At most4 actual reviewed TBB library dirs permitted for official; none for Xe.
UR_ADAPTERS_FORCE_LOAD is fixed to each engine's OWN provider/lib/libur_adapter_level_zero_v2.so.0.12.0. No foreign adapter. Actual provider-native libsycl and L0 adapter required,
all selected mapped library path/canonical SHA/stat/GNU build-ID identities admitted. Mapping includes SYCL/UR/L0,
UMF, compiler/driver, math/MKL/TBB/iomp and stdlib/libc. It is a bounded selected-library map, not every OS mapping.
At most64 files,512MiB per file,4GiB aggregate ready/done file+ELF reads; preflight permits total mapped-file
bytes no greater than (4GiB-128MiB)/2 to cover two snapshots and notes. Missing build-ID is recorded as null; new/unpinned map refuses.
Actual source clean HEAD/status/diff, interpreter/Git/journalctl/systemctl file hashes and input stat identities
are rechecked under owned guards. Git guards are READ ONLY; no Git mutation is in this controller.

Routes and R207/R208/R209/R210/R211
Read R207-R211 in v1 and R215/R216 in full for this derivative. R211 became available before final and supersedes R209's legacy SYCL macro claims.
Xe policy uses actual --short-read 0 --prefill 8192 --prefill-experts 16 --no-prefill-borrow with separate argv
values, STRATA_VERIFY_SEGMENTED=1, DEVICE_PLAN=0, EVENT_MARK=barrier, requested ring8 (effective>=16 at8K), inline issuer0, CPU share/gate0. R216's conditional skipped-entry threaded issuer race is avoided by issuer0.
No STRATA_SYCL_PREFILL_SAME_QUEUE/VERIFY_OVERLAP: absent from this actual Xe macro-selected implementation.
Prefill creates a separate copy queue; source event dependencies, not a same-queue claim, order it. R211 notes
ignored intermediate event/copy return values. Main must explicitly review this limitation and actual macro
configuration (backend=xe, strata_enable_sycl=false) before admitting even this diagnostic. The controller cannot
retrofit error handling into pristine source and does not prove that silently ignored errors never occur.
Xe STRATA_PRELOAD_KERNELS=0 is NOT implemented here and is NOT set: the actual all-ID preload remains on.
Official uses only --short-read 65536 --spec 8 --suffix-draft 0 --no-spec-split expressed as separate argv values,
STRATA_VERIFY_STEPPED=1, PIPE=0, NO_HOST=0, DEVICE_PLAN=1. STRATA_DEC_BATCH is left at
its source default. No --batch/--pipeline-windows, MTP, image segments, or batched multichunk prefill request.
R207's Stager/PLE host volatile marker blockers are avoided by the actual read_windows route, not claimed fixed.
Both request native canonical GGUF/PLE pack, max-context262144, fixed int8 KV/resident32768, no-KV-grow,
expert-cache128 and exact profile/per-layer placement, pool-workers5, PCIe fraction0, adapt-swaps0,
conversation-cache-mib0, prompt-cache0, turn-token-1, suffix-draft0, greedy. MTP/chain/EOS-stop/session reuse absent.
The spare spec capacity is4 for Xe and8 for official; no drafting is loaded. Official startup may still allocate
its source-default prompt buffers; this is not a claim that all batched code is removed from the executable.
INFO asserts real context/KV/spec/lookup/workers/PCIe/cache, positive decimal expert_slots<=24576, free VRAM>=512MiB; startup records actual slots without prediction. Model requires equality to its successful sameboot reviewed startup actual slots. Qualification expected_info contains only fixed policy keys;
Main-resolved actual selected-device/backend stderr lines must appear. Native+PLE compatibility is a required
new Main source/build admission. The controller makes no default-optimality or memory-fit claim.

Input and protocol/timing
Canonical65,536 IDs SHA5284d8fa53d1ef28f6ba916a629faf901c890bc0c669bf986ee04ed72aa2c3ff and old verified49
suffix manifest SHA0fbf6a16a90b55a3767145d1217b2027e218c0537a487faa428ab6527e6771b1. Validate ALL parent IDs
0<=id<248320; derive exactly first32719 +last49 into fresh run tokens.txt, never overwrite the canonical fixture.
GEN16 ckpt=0 logprobs=5, no cache. Strict RESUME0 / PP / REUSED0 / paired16 T+LP5 / final16-field DONE,
finite times/logprobs, valid unique top5 domains, length16, fresh read_n32768, zero draft accepted/offered.
Xe requires PP8192/16384/24576/32767, four exact trace offsets and one32767-token batched part. Official requires
PP32767, no batched chunk traces, one32767-token windows part. The last prompt token is the first decode-window
input, so32768 input is not a claim that the batched prefix itself had32768 positions. Official's prefix has
4095 full8-row windows plus one7-row window; first decode consumes the last prompt token separately.
Record each startup wall, PP sample, traced part sample, engine DONE prefill/decode ms, monotonic protocol events,
wall GEN->REUSED prefill boundary, REUSED->DONE decode boundary, TTFT/full GEN wall, every T/LP5 and SHA fingerprint.
These are observed protocol wall boundaries including pipe/scheduling/validation overhead; engine timings are
retained separately. LP5/token equality is NOT full-vocabulary parity or broad quality. No speed claim from startup.

Health, limits, closure, failures
Per run new Main health receipt <=120s old, same boot/provider, exact probe command/env/libraries/integer protocol,
one Level Zero GPU/index0/PCI0000:05:00.0 normal and <=256MiB initial usage, fresh kernel fault gate. The controller
then runs a new same-provider health before model and after SUCCESS only, with same explicit phase environment.
Model/startup env is an explicit allowlist; HOME/LANG/PATH/LD/runtime dirs only, no inherited credentials, PTI,
unitrace, profiler, cache/service overrides or foreign adapter. NEOReadDebugKeys1, EnableDirectSubmission0,
UR_L0_V2_FORCE_DISABLE_COPY_OFFLOAD1 retain the previously qualified normal runtime settings as requested by Main;
provider-native adapter forcing applies identically to health/model. CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER explicitly records both
pristine entry points' existing automatic source default; no CUDA/HIP code or selected Level Zero arithmetic changes.
Startup environment: loader/UR debug + validation, model: warning + validation; STRATA_TRACE stays on. Overhead
is recorded; there is no clean-speed eligibility. A new devcoredump always stops admission/active poll.
Fresh journal cursor before health; bounded65,536 rows/complete relevant Xe+PCI messages and fault filter before,
after and finally. Initial host available and every known cgroup2 ancestor reserve>=80GiB; unknown/nonunified
cgroup refuses. Root with no memory controller cap uses physical reserve. Embedding service must already be
inactive; controller only reads its state, never changes it. No GPU reset/unbind/service commands or retries.
Combined owned stdout/stderr64MiB, all files below each fresh root96MiB, per file64MiB, model session RSS88GiB,
metadata utility RSS4GiB, model CPU3600s, open FDs256, core dumps0. Controller process-memory overhead is separate
from the model-session RSS metric. Main should include controller/metadata overhead in its outer finite job budget.
Once the fresh admitted root starts, total controller deadline300s startup /1800s model including owned utility
commands; model owner gets at most remaining time, startup also has an absolute300s READY deadline. Qualified
owner failure cleanup/observation may add its bounded closure interval; forced cleanup can never PASS.
Owned progress metadata every30s reports elapsed/stderr bytes (I/O activity, not proof of algorithmic progress).
Official long no-stdout window reads use the whole remaining deadline, not a120s fake heartbeat requirement.
Normal QUIT/30s reap whenever READY idle/DONE/ERR responds. Primary failure remains recorded even if QUIT closes.
Nonresponsive/over-budget paths use only qualified owner's identity-pinned pidfd emergency enforcement; no
numeric process-group kills, raw kill commands, unknown-owner adoption or reset. All forced closures are failed.
Only specifically enumerated build statuses before the observed READY boundary are reviewable startup diagnostics.
A compile word cannot exempt another UR/ZE error enum, even on the same line. READY stores a stderr byte offset
at the last complete line; the partial line remains strict so an enum cannot straddle and vanish. Every new
post-READY UR/ZE ERROR enum, [ERROR], fatal/asynchronous/device-loss message fails, even build errors. Successful
compile progress alone does not fail. Protocol diagnostics are kept separately from pre-READY startup messages.
Protocol ERR/nonfinite and fresh kernel faults fail. Startup compilation diagnostics require Main's actual reviewed-startup pin before GEN; pending subprocess fixtures trap attempted owner import.
R215 supports final prompt commit drain before serial T=1 decode; R216 retains the prefill workspace and sources
through decode, while lookahead copy work may remain in flight in separate live prefill buffers. Neither is a
complete transfer-quiescence or exceptional teardown qualification. Existing ignored-event/teardown limitations
remain explicitly reviewed; the controller cannot detect a truly unlogged failure or claim full numerical parity.
Complete raw bounded stderr is retained, relevant message lines compacted (1MiB cap); no cleanup or deletion.
This cannot prove no silent numerical error from ignored pristine API returns. No partial output is promoted to
correctness/quality parity; failed/incomplete roots remain failed and block campaign continuation.

Qualification and remaining gates
Source-only package supplies unresolved qualification.pending.json/fresh-health.pending.json. No PENDING/TODO/
UNRESOLVED admission string may survive; new source/controller CPU/review/build/runtime/native+PLE/model identity
and fresh health proofs are required. Model hashes can reference an immutable earlier successful DATA hash phase,
but no old controller/source/binary receipt is relabelled valid for these binaries and no original status changes.
Main review TODOs are explicit in MAIN_REVIEW_TODOS.txt. Tests/import/AST/lints/compiler/builds/GPU/model/process
queries and Git/cleanup were not performed here. No runtime parsed-output correctness, fit, fault freedom,
performance, full262144 capacity, RESTORE or broad numerical quality result exists from this source packet.

Main v4 derivative: exact SHA/stat/mapped identity remains mandatory, optional GNU build-ID absence is explicit. Selected device source regex uses actual qualified name and records observed metrics. Installed UMF1.1 and compiler opt/compiler/lib search paths are included. Utility XDG/DBUS allowlist supports read-only user-service state. No model run yet.

Main derivation: independent official-only namespace; mandatory --prefill8; model/controller wall3600s, CPU bounded by affinity*wall+60, progress rows bounded bywall/30+4. Active GEN receives supported STOP with90s normal-close reserve. Original failed/canceled arms remain unchanged; no pristine engine source changes.
